text:
sqlpipe v2.0 is available.

Breaking change: The `/v2/users` response no longer includes `name`.
The response now includes `first_name` and `last_name`.
If your client reads `name`, update it before you deploy v2.0.
If a client still reads `name`, the client will receive no value for that field.

This release adds the `--incremental` flag.
Use `--incremental` to process only rows that changed since the last run.
This mode reduces work for repeat sync jobs.

Parquet writes are 40% faster in v2.0.
Large exports finish sooner, and pipelines spend less time in the write step.
No schema change is required for Parquet output.
